{"command": "
python3 << 'PYEND'
# Write the parser file in chunks
with open('/app/src/sql/parser/parser.rs', 'w') as f:
    f.write('use std::iter::Peekable;\n')
    f.write('use std::ops::Add;\n\n')
    f.write('use super::{Keyword, Lexer, Token, ast};\n')
    f.write('use crate::errinput;\n')
    f.write('use crate::error::Result;\n')
    f.write('use crate::sql::types::DataType;\n\n')
    f.write('pub struct Parser<\'a> {\n')
    f.write('    pub lexer: Peekable<Lexer<\'a>>,\n')
    f.write('}\n\n')
    f.write('impl Parser<\'_> {\n')
    f.write('    pub fn parse(statement: &str) -> Result<ast::Statement> {\n')
    f.write('        let mut parser = Parser::new(statement);\n')
    f.write('        let stmt = parser.parse_statement()?;\n')
    f.write('        if let Some(token) = parser.peek()? {\n')
    f.write('            if !matches!(token, Token::Semicolon) {\n')
    f.write('                return errinput!("unexpected token after statement: {}", token);\n')
    f.write('            }\n')
    f.write('        }\n')
    f.write('        Ok(stmt)\n')
    f.write('    }\n\n')
    f.write('    #[cfg(test)]\n')
    f.write('    pub fn parse_expr(expr: &str) -> Result<ast::Expression> {\n')
    f.write('        let mut parser = Parser::new(expr);\n')
    f.write('        let expr = parser.parse_expression()?;\n')
    f.write('        if parser.peek()?.is_some() {\n')
    f.write('            return errinput!("unexpected tokens after expression");\n')
    f.write('        }\n')
    f.write('        Ok(expr)\n')
    f.write('    }\n\n')
    f.write('    fn new(input: &str) -> Parser<\'_> {\n')
    f.write('        Parser {\n')
    f.write('            lexer: Lexer::new(input).peekable(),\n')
    f.write('        }\n')
    f.write('    }\n\n')
    f.write('    fn next(&mut self) -> Result<Token> {\n')
    f.write('        self.lexer.next().unwrap_or_else(|| errinput!("unexpected end of input"))\n')
    f.write('    }\n\n')
    f.write('    fn next_ident(&mut self) -> Result<String> {\n')
    f.write('        match self.next()? {\n')
    f.write('            Token::Ident(name) => Ok(name),\n')
    f.write('            Token::Keyword(k) => Ok(k.to_string()),\n')
    f.write('            other => errinput!("expected identifier, got {}", other),\n')
    f.write('        }\n')
    f.write('    }\n\n')
    f.write('    fn next_if(&mut self, predicate: impl Fn(&Token) -> bool) -> Option<Token> {\n')
    f.write('        if self.lexer.peek().map_or(false, |t| predicate(t)) {\n')
    f.write('            self.lexer.next().unwrap()\n')
    f.write('        } else {\n')
    f.write('            None\n')
    f.write('        }\n')
    f.write('    }\n\n')
    f.write('    fn next_if_map<T>(&mut self, f: impl Fn(&Token) -> Option<T>) -> Option<T> {\n')
    f.write('        if let Some(token) = self.lexer.peek() {\n')
    f.write('            if let Some(result) = f(token) {\n')
    f.write('                self.lexer.next();\n')
    f.write('                return Some(result);\n')
    f.write('            }\n')
    f.write('        }\n')
    f.write('        None\n')
    f.write('    }\n\n')
    f.write('    fn next_if_keyword(&mut self) -> Option<Keyword> {\n')
    f.write('        self.next_if_map(|t| match t {\n')
    f.write('            Token::Keyword(k) => Some(*k),\n')
    f.write('            _ => None,\n')
    f.write('        })\n')
    f.write('    }\n\n')
    f.write('    fn next_is(&mut self, token: Token) -> bool {\n')
    f.write('        self.next_if(|t| t == &token).is_some()\n')
    f.write('    }\n\n')
    f.write('    fn expect(&mut self, expect: Token) -> Result<()> {\n')
    f.write('        let token = self.next()?;\n')
    f.write('        if token == expect {\n')
    f.write('            Ok(())\n')
    f.write('        } else {\n')
    f.write('            errinput!("expected {}, got {}", expect, token)\n')
    f.write('        }\n')
    f.write('    }\n\n')
    f.write('    fn skip(&mut self, token: Token) {\n')
    f.write('        self.next_is(token);\n')
    f.write('    }\n\n')
    f.write('    fn peek(&mut self) -> Result<Option<&Token>> {\n')
    f.write('        Ok(self.lexer.peek())\n')
    f.write('    }\n')
print('Part 1 done')
PYEND
", "security_risk": "MEDIUM"}
